name: Fenrir
prompt:

Rich textured brushwork, aged brass, ink, dramatic chiaroscuro, restrained luminous magic, sophisticated fantasy book illustration. Landscape 3:2. ONE dominant subject fills central 70 percent; face in central upper third, important anatomy within frame, large strong silhouette readable at 150 pixels. Background atmospheric and less detailed than subject. No text, no typography, no words, no numbers, no frame, no UI, no watermark. Non-graphic fantasy, no blood or injuries. Human characters adults and fully clothed in armor or layered opaque robes.
Subject: A colossal charcoal grey wolf with icy blue eyes, windblown fur and fractured golden magical chains across its shoulders, jaws snarling without blood. Clearly a wolf, huge weight and menace.
World: Mythic Norse world, icy fjords, weathered iron, pale blue northern light and ember amber; Scandinavian saga atmosphere.
Boss portrait: imposing, iconic, distinct from ordinary creatures.
